name: Grid Stack
description: Places the inputs in a grid, row by row, each scaled into a cell of the first input's frame, like FFmpeg's xstack grid layout.

inputs.name: src
inputs.description: Videos to place in the grid, any sizes

params.name: columns
params.description: Columns of the grid; the rows follow from the number of inputs. 0 = the square root of the number of inputs, rounded up

params.name: fit
params.description: Keep each input's aspect ratio inside its cell (bars in the fill color) instead of stretching it to the cell

params.name: fill
params.description: Fill for unused cells and for the bars of fit
